verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only narrow, feature-specific exports: ASC 718 report calculations as an Excel (.xlsx) file and scenario-model exports for team review. Nothing documents a complete account or cap-table data export, or an offboarding path. Probes found no public API or OpenAPI spec that could serve as an alternative way to pull data out. Missing for 10: a documented full-account or cap-table data export, export of data-room documents in bulk, open/standard formats (e.g., CSV or OCF) across all data, a documented offboarding or migration process, and independent corroboration.
